behavior.text: Proprioceptive feedback: FeCO club/claw/hook neurons encode femur-tibia joint angle, movement direction and vibration; they terminate in the thoracic VNC ganglia and ascend to the brain. Known biology (textbook).
behavior.basis: Mamiya et al. FeCO functional types (club=position, claw=movement direction, hook=vibration); stated as known biology, NOT as a simulation result.

fly_narration: The leg knows where it is.
honest_note: REAL measured FlyWire v783 rows throughout. Hop-1 skips ontology parents, transmitter buckets, and Notch hemilineage developmental buckets (documented heuristic). Dead avenues: FBbt_00048275 (club ascending neuron) 0 rows all forms; upstream of adult proprioceptive projection neuron FBbt_00052033 0 rows; per-pair FeCO->FBbt_00052033 0 pairs (the second-order proprioceptive neuron is not a direct FeCO target in the index). The functional club/claw/hook subtypes (Mamiya et al.) are not separately indexed as connectivity classes — this walk is at the whole-FeCO level.
